schema.description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from VANDEN-ABEELE-PXI-2020 abstract (OpenAlex work record of doi 10.1016/j.ijhcs.2019.102370): PXI measures player experience both at the level of Functional Consequences (the immediate experiences as a direct result of game design choices, such as audiovisual appeal or ease-of-control) and at the level of Psychosocial Consequences (the second-order emotional experiences, such as immersion or mastery).

construct.description: The construct measured at that level (the abstract names audiovisual appeal and ease-of-control, immersion and mastery; the full list is in the paywalled paper).

level.description: The two levels of Means-End theory the scale measures.

schema.title: PXI measurement level
